title: exception-register
description: Structured exception register produced from a completed control-test cycle. Carries scope, per-exception classification (control-failure / design-gap / evidence-gap / scope-disagreement / data-integrity / anomaly), severity with rationale, root-cause hypothesis, repeat-issue flag, disposition, and the issue handoff package downstream issue write-up consumes via source_exception_id. Downstream consumers: workpaper-drafter (consumes the register by exception_register_id and pulls classification summary into the workpaper); risk-compliance-core/skills/issue-writeup (keys off source_exception_id, pulls the per-exception handoff package without re-discovering criterion / condition / cause / effect / recommendation seed); qa-workpaper (full record review for sufficiency).

analysis_id.description: Stable identifier per firm naming convention.

control_id.description: Firm control register ID for the control under test.

obligation_ids.description: Firm obligation register IDs the control addresses.

engagement_id.description: Pointer to the engagement-scope record (engagement-scoping output). Optional; absent when scope was not formalised separately from the test plan.

jurisdictions.description: Primary first; secondary jurisdictions follow if multi-jurisdiction.

scope_statement.description: Two to three sentences. Population, timeframe, in / out of scope.

role.description: Separate role from preparer; reviewer separation is structural.

exception_id.description: Stable across the engagement. Feeds source_exception_id on the issue side.

sample_id.description: Sample item from the workpaper sample-level results.

population_reference.description: Stratum or segment label if stratified.

criterion_source.description: Rule, principle, policy section, or methodology with section reference, cited by file path into references/source-anchors.md or loaded overlays.

condition.description: Dated, scoped, observable state — what the test actually saw. Specific. Not a conclusion.

severity_rationale.description: Frequency, customer impact, regulatory exposure, materiality against firm thresholds, compensating controls.

description.description: Specific control attribute that failed; 'root cause analysis pending' if genuinely unknown.

prior_issue_id.description: Issue log ID of the prior open or closed issue when repeat_issue is true.

disposition_rationale.description: Why this disposition. For closed-at-exception, the supplemental evidence reviewed. For re-test or expanded-sample, the criteria for what closes it.

issue_handoff.description: Populated when disposition is elevated-to-issue. Bridge into risk-compliance-core/skills/issue-writeup; that skill keys off source_exception_id and consumes these fields without re-discovery.

effect.description: Impact with unit and time window — financial, customer, regulatory, operational, reputational.

recommendation_seed.description: Declarative remediation direction; the issue writer refines into the recommendation field.

rollup_grouping.description: Issue rollup label when multiple exceptions roll up into a single issue.

evidence_gap_flags.description: [evidence needed] markers carried into the engagement issue log.

tolerable_deviation_rate.description: From the test plan. If unset on the test plan, that is a test-plan defect — flag back, do not invent here.

anomaly_or_systemic.description: Default systemic; downgrade to anomaly only with positive evidence the deviation does not recur.

projection_commentary.description: Concentration in a particular segment, channel, region, process step. Sample-design implications.

reviewer_questions.description: Items the preparer wants the named reviewer to consider before sign-off. A question the preparer answers themselves is not a reviewer question.

limitations_and_reliance.description: What this register does not classify; reliance on prior testing or vendor SOC reliance carried in from the workpaper; source posture limits.

human_review_required.description: Always true. Severity assignment and disposition carry human review.
